feastLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. Nino has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Anaconda Empress — I put it down today." "The water bulges — a ripple with intent." "It loosens, reluctantly, and pours itself back into the water. It will remember this pool." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. James mutters "Say that again — slower." Joseph asks "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
💛 The Rebecca's Ring is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — anchor: chasers tire faster when you flee, while worn.)
💛 The Carpenter's square is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)
💛 The Tasting Spoon is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)
💛 The Seed packet is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)

🔥 The fire settles. Cheryl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nightlight — I put it down today." "A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty." "The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Colton says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Yuki mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
✦ Colton has found something — Surgeon's Calm. Days of triage and steady_hands side by side, and now they move as one. (surgeons_calm: villager synergy discovered)
🧳 A traveler swears Thornfield, southeast, is feasting — a whole elk, they say. (They're wrong. Thornfield is starving.)
✦ Nino has found something — Surgeon's Calm. Days of triage and steady_hands side by side, and now they move as one. (surgeons_calm: villager synergy discovered)
What Wilhelm kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.

🔥 The fire settles. Colton has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nino says "And you're still standing." Ella mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
✦ James has found something — Surgeon's Calm. Days of triage and steady_hands side by side, and now they move as one. (surgeons_calm: villager synergy discovered)

🔥 The fire settles. Nino has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Cheryl asks "So it bleeds." Ava mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
